BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE The organisation seeks to appoint a qualified service provider to supply, configure, and support reusable Moodle licences for a period of twelve (12) months. The Moodle platform will be used to deliver External Integrated Summative Assessments (EISA) for occupational qualifications. The system must support secure, scalable, and reliable online assessments aligned with QCTO requirements. 3. SCOPE OF WORK The appointed service provider will be required to: 3.1.
